customize.name: Crispy Spring Rolls
customize.desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. Shredded meat and vegetables are wrapped in a thin pancake, rolled into a tube, and then fried until golden. Crunchy on the outside, smooth on the inside, these little delicacies are cherished by old and young alike.

customize.name: Delicious Crispy Spring Rolls
customize.desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. With a crisp crack, the juicy filling bursts forth as you bite. Beneath the golden, flaky shell are not only layers of flavor, but the vibrant, bustling spirit of Liyue itself.

customize.name: Suspicious Crispy Spring Rolls
customize.desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. The crust was supposed to be crisp, but somehow it ended up soft and soggy — how strange... Wait, could this be the oil paper used to wrap the food...?

customize.name: Zibai
customize.desc: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

customize.name: Flavor of Spring
customize.desc: Zibai's specialty. Its color gleams like golden amber, reminiscent of her eyes. Its aroma is as familiar as a simple spring roll, yet each crisp bite reveals an unexpected resilience... Could this be a secret recipe from ancient Lang-Gan?
